kind.description: What kind of honor this is. Absent means unspecified. Domain-specific details such as category, placing or result stay in the title and description.

links.description: Public sources for the honor (announcements, articles, certificates, result lists).

issuer.description: Organization or entity that granted the honor.

agentRef.description: The issuer that granted the honor, as a single nested reference mirroring the flat issuer / issuerDid / entityRef fields. Additive dual-write: the flat fields remain the source of truth for existing consumers.

awardedAt.description: Date the honor was awarded, in YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

entityRef.description: Portable, app-neutral identifier for the issuing organization the user selected from a resolver dropdown: a Wikidata Q-ID URI (http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q...), a ROR URI, or an LEI URI. Enables deterministic resolution to a canonical entity even before the organization claims an ATproto account. Absent for free-text entries.

issuerDid.description: DID of the issuing entity's ATproto account, if one exists.

description.description: Description of the honor or award.

main.description: Record representing a single honor or award.
main.x-skos:note: schema:award is a bare string, so issuer and date are lost. No better term exists in BIBO either.

description: An honor, award, or recognition received by the user.
